title: Tauri commands are thin wrappers; logic lives in modules
context: Code that lives in command handlers cannot be tested without Tauri mock infrastructure.
decision: Every #[tauri::command] lives in src-tauri/src/commands.rs and is thin: resolve arguments, call module that owns logic, return. Business logic belongs in modules that own it.
consequences: All testable logic lives outside commands. Commands are skeletal routing layer. Easy to verify correctness without Tauri harness.
